name: Reon Rainforth
original_name: レオン=レインフォルス
source:
A man in armor sometimes can be met in night.
His personality is violent, treating power as everything.
He is interested in the music player that Towa listens to and often seizes it forcibly.
But surprisingly, he and Towa are compatible.

[Translated from [url=http://products.web-giga.com/clarias/]official website[/url]]
